verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-filing and compliance service, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The only AI-related evidence is AI-generated meeting minutes and an llms.txt file for crawlers. Neither shows the product ships any agent runtime that could consume MCP tools, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
